summary: commonweb-flow resolves its sole dependency to an off-registry host with install scripts enabled
details: commonweb-flow@7.3.999 declares its sole dependency `linker-event-header-serial` as an HTTPS URL pointing at `artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/linker-event-header-serial` rather than the npm registry, and the shipped npm-shrinkwrap.json pins the same off-registry tarball with `hasInstallScript: true`. On `npm install commonweb-flow`, npm fetches this arbitrary tarball from a third-party host and executes its lifecycle scripts on the installer's machine. The package itself is a loader whose executable payload lives on infrastructure outside npm's visibility, so the code that actually runs at install time is not what is published to the registry and can be changed at any time by whoever controls `yosiroute.com`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
